affirmations: Small reps, every day. That’s how a mind grows.
Mistakes are just your brain finding the edges.
You don’t have to be fast today. Just be here.
Curiosity is a superpower. Use it on something small.
Rest is part of training, not a break from it.
Every new thing you try leaves a little trail in your brain.
Progress you can’t see yet is still progress.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Brain Games is free to play without an account. When you play as a guest, your progress stays in this browser and we store nothing.

sections.heading: What we store
sections.body: When you sign in with Google, we store your Google user id, your name, your email and your profile picture in Firebase Authentication. We store your garden (name, avatar, scores, history, days played, growth points and settings) in Cloud Firestore.

sections.heading: Why we store it
sections.body: Only to keep your progress safe and the same on every device. We do not use analytics, ads or tracking, and we never sell or share your data.

sections.heading: Where it lives
sections.body: Your garden is stored in Google Cloud Firestore in Mumbai, India (asia-south1). Only you can read or change it.

sections.heading: What Google shows us
sections.body: The Google popup asks only for your basic profile and email (openid, email, profile). We cannot see your Gmail, Drive or contacts.

sections.heading: How to delete it
sections.body: Open your profile and choose "Delete my cloud data". This removes your garden from the cloud and signs you out. The copy in this browser stays until you reset it.
